wetj09q9.variantName: Christmas Tree World 12ft Ultra Devonshire Fir - Warm White/Multi-Colour Lights
wetj09q9.sourceDescription: Our most popular pre-lit Christmas tree, the 12ft Ultra Devonshire Fir tree combines stunning realism with a wonderful lighting display. There's no need to untangle any Christmas lights yourself with this one. Just click the button on the controller box to soften your tree with a warm white or go kaleidoscopic with the multicoloured option - the lighting choice is all yours! There are 8 different lighting functions, including the classic 'always on' as well as the unique flashing function that effortlessly mixes both colours together. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included. Product Features • Size: 12ft • Number of branch tips: 5232 PE/PVC branch tips • Pre-lit: Professionally hand strung with 2010 LED lights • Tree width: 202cm diameter • LED colour-changing technology: Both warm white & multicolour modes • Functions: Multifunctional with 8 settings including static • Foliage colour: Dark natural green • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The tree's construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

tkq0ndcd.variantName: Scottish Everlastings 180cm Satin Bow Garland - Red, Pink and Orange
tkq0ndcd.sourceDescription: Bring vibrant festive charm to your home with this 180cm satin bow garland in a striking red, pink and orange colourway. Featuring a series of beautifully tied satin bows, it adds a playful yet elegant touch to your Christmas décor. Perfect for draping across mantels, staircases, doorways, or windows, this garland instantly brightens any space with its rich, joyful hues. The luxurious satin finish catches the light, creating a subtle shimmer that adds sophistication to your seasonal displays. Lightweight and easy to style, it offers endless decorating possibilities, whether layered with greenery, paired with candles, or displayed on its own for a bold statement. Add a splash of colour and a festive flourish with this eye catching 180cm satin bow garland. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Garland Length: L180cm. Materials: Polyester, nylon. For indoor use only SEL UK Ltd Frances Industrial Park, Wemyss Road, Kirkcaldy KY12XZ
